decision: Use DQN only as a gated policy layer after a supervised return-aware encoder demonstrates real out-of-sample signal.
non_claims: DQN does not repair the current transformer's forecast accuracy.
DQN does not create an economic edge when the state contains no usable information.
The existing checkpoint is not approved for live trading or capital allocation.
No profitability is claimed until a replacement sealed holdout and live shadow test pass.

prerequisite_gates.condition: At least 240 qualified pre-holdout sessions, or enough for five full rolling folds, with executable bid/ask, independent receive time, exchange sequence/checksum evidence, effective-dated metadata, and measured fee/funding inputs.
Tick-aware sparse transforms, continuous warm-up, strict feature cutoff, and under 1% clipping per valid feature.
Return-distribution score improves at least 5% over the strongest registered simple baseline across every development fold and seed, with directional MCC above 0.10.
A frozen cost-aware threshold or tree policy is non-negative after base costs across development folds; otherwise stop before RL.
Use nested rolling folds with horizon-aware purge and embargo; fit scalers, encoders, replay, reward normalization, and policy selection inside each training fold only.

validation_design.folds: Pre-register at least five rolling anchored folds with at least 120 prior train sessions, 20 chronological selection sessions, horizon-aware purge and embargo equal to the maximum label/reward/n-step/holding reach, and 20 disjoint untouched test sessions per fold; no replay transition or episode crosses a boundary. Follow with one physically sealed replacement holdout.
validation_design.seeds: Use at least five Transformer seeds and ten DQN seeds for the finalist; report every seed and fold, not only the champion.
validation_design.fold_locality: Generate Transformer states fold-locally or out-of-fold. Validation, policy-selection, and holdout transitions never enter replay, normalization, early stopping, or target construction.
validation_design.checkpoint_rule: The existing 2.09M checkpoint may define an architecture candidate but its weights cannot initialize a fold whose validation or test dates it previously saw; retrain weights fold-locally.
validation_design.statistics: Seeds are not independent market samples. Aggregate paired daily and weekly results inside folds and use block-bootstrap confidence intervals.
validation_design.trial_control: Pre-register seeds, the trial budget, ablations, selection metric, costs, latency, fills, reward coefficients, and one champion-selection rule before confirmation; retain failed trials.

inputs: spread, depth, imbalance, realized volatility, and data-quality flags
fees, funding, and effective instrument metadata

supervised_encoder.topology: The CHMT-Q modality topology is retained only as a candidate, with a compact 0.2-0.5M parameter version as a required ablation against the current 2.09M architecture.
supervised_encoder.training: Retrain weights inside every rolling fold on executable-return distributions; generate policy states fold-locally or out-of-fold and keep footprint targets at low auxiliary weight.
auxiliary_heads: POC, volume, and delta only when an ablation proves incremental value

market_state: spread, liquidity, funding, time, and data-quality features
policy_state_adapter.normalization: Fit on the training partition only; no reward, state, or portfolio statistic may use future or validation data.

dqn_policy.initial_algorithm: Dueling Double DQN with target network, Huber TD loss, uniform day-balanced trajectory replay, and short multi-step returns.
dqn_policy.optional_ablation: Quantile Regression DQN and conservative Q regularization only after the initial DQN and simple policies pass identical folds, seeds, and costs.
dqn_policy.encoder_update_policy: Freeze the encoder first. Unfreeze only the top block at a lower learning rate if paired folds and seeds improve without degrading the supervised heads.
dqn_policy.rejected_training_mode: Do not train the full transformer and DQN jointly from scratch on the current one-month corpus.
dqn_policy.action_confidence: Abstain to the current target or flat unless the lower-confidence Q advantage clears a frozen reserve; stale, out-of-distribution, or risk-breach states force flat.

actions.semantics: Actions are target positions, not raw market orders.
actions.execution_rule: Trade only the difference between the selected target and current position. Re-selecting the current target is the no-trade/hold outcome.
actions.why_not_buy_sell_hold_commands: A command-style HOLD cannot also represent closing to flat; target positions make transitions and turnover unambiguous.

environment.simulator_class: Exogenous historical counterfactual simulator at fixed small notional, not logged-behavior offline RL. The selected action changes only portfolio state, never the recorded market path.
environment.transition: At each five-minute decision, observe only information available at cutoff, execute the target-position change after frozen latency against executable bid/ask, then mark equity at the next decision.
environment.episode_length: Use contiguous multi-day blocks; carry state across UTC boundaries and force-close only at episode end with the closing cost charged.
environment.market_impact_scope: Initial research assumes fixed small notional and exogenous market data; a separate capacity/impact gate is mandatory before any capital request.
risk_limits: action masks for stale or invalid market state
predeclared drawdown and daily-loss kill switches
forced close and cost reconciliation at episode end

reward.formula: r_t = log(E_{t+1}/E_t) - lambda_dd * max(0, DD_{t+1}-DD_t) - lambda_turn * abs(p_t-p_{t-1})
reward.equity_accounting: E is executable liquidation equity and charges bid/ask, fees, frozen slippage, funding, realized PnL, mark-to-market PnL, and terminal closing cost exactly once.
reward.evaluation_rule: Select and report raw net PnL and risk separately from shaped reward. Any drawdown or turnover shaping coefficient is pre-registered, and accounting tests must prove it does not replace or duplicate ledger costs.
reward.normalization: Normalize from training-only reward statistics and do not clip away basis-point differences.
forbidden_rewards: unrealized PnL without eventual closing cost

training_program.name: Environment certification
training_program.work: Prove timestamp causality, action transitions, accounting identity, cost reconciliation, deterministic replay, and forced-close behavior with synthetic fixtures.

training_program.name: Supervised encoder
training_program.work: Train direct executable-return and risk heads inside at least five nested rolling folds with purge and embargo; compare recent, seasonal, linear, tree, TCN, and compact-transformer baselines across at least five seeds.

training_program.name: Frozen-encoder DQN
training_program.work: Train only the state adapter and DQN head on fold-local or out-of-fold states from training folds. Select on a separate chronological policy block and evaluate the finalist across at least ten DQN seeds.
training_program.exit: Paired raw net-PnL improvement over the best frozen non-RL policy across folds and seeds.

training_program.name: Controlled encoder fine-tune
training_program.work: Optionally unfreeze the top transformer block with a lower learning rate; retain a frozen-encoder control and supervised-loss guardrail.
training_program.exit: RL utility improves without forecast-score regression or instability.

training_program.name: Calibration and policy freeze
training_program.work: Freeze action thresholds, risk limits, costs, latency, reward coefficients, and model selection before any final holdout access.
training_program.exit: Immutable policy manifest and reproducible checkpoint.

training_program.name: Replacement holdout
training_program.work: Open one physically sealed later period of at least 60 sessions exactly once, with hashes, access logs, minimum activity rules, and a blind extension rule; do not reuse Jun 25-30 as pristine evidence.
training_program.exit: All forecast, policy, cost, risk, and stability gates pass without retuning.

training_program.name: Live shadow
training_program.work: Run the identical frozen policy with learning disabled, live timestamps, order-book state, fail-flat controls, and slippage reconciliation before any capital request or order route.
training_program.exit: At least 60 shadow days with no causal, accounting, or risk-control breach.

required_baselines_and_ablations: always flat, always long, always short, buy-and-hold, and turnover-matched random target-position policies
cost-aware supervised threshold and tree policy
bars only, bars plus L1, and bars plus L1 plus L2
zero-cost accounting sanity check versus frozen base and stress costs
oracle upper bound used only as a diagnostic and never as a trainable baseline
champion comparison corrected for the pre-registered number of trials
negative_controls: shuffle transformer states within training days
inject a deliberate future-leak sentinel and require the causal audit to reject it
train on one regime and verify failure is detected on another
verify that validation and replacement holdout data never enter replay

go_no_go_gates.condition: At least 5% paired proper-score gain over the strongest simple baseline with a 95% lower confidence bound above zero, positive in at least four of five folds, directional MCC above 0.10, and useful interval coverage and sharpness.

DQN beats the best frozen non-RL policy in paired block-bootstrap raw net PnL with a 95% lower confidence bound above zero; if position state, switching cost, duration, and risk state add no sequential value, select the supervised policy instead.
Positive base- and stress-cost net return, with estimated gross edge at least 3x frozen all-in round-trip cost.
Max drawdown, downside tail, daily loss, exposure, and turnover remain inside predeclared portfolio limits in every fold and seed.

Across at least five rolling folds, five Transformer seeds, and ten DQN seeds, at least four of five fold medians and 80% of seed-fold runs are profitable, no fold or day supplies over 30% of profit, and supervised score does not regress after fine-tuning.
Random, shuffled-state, and shuffled-reward controls fail; always-flat and simple-policy comparisons are reported.
One pre-registered champion passes at least 60 physically sealed untouched days once with no retuning, followed by at least 60 live shadow days with learning disabled.

policy: net return and net utility after frozen costs
turnover, exposure, action occupancy, and break-even cost
paired daily and weekly block-bootstrap confidence intervals
performance by fold, seed, day, and regime
